a finding never negates generation, delivery or release
It must not reinterpret existing reports.
It may begin only when every item below is satisfied and evidenced
Behaviour on synthetic fixtures says nothing about model output in the field
A gate whose error rate is unknown cannot have its cost weighed against its benefit
Blocking on rules with known holes trades real availability for illusory assurance
Blocking on an unclassified finding set means blocking on everything
The blocking set must be enumerable and defensible
A gate with no escape hatch becomes a reason to disable the gate
The policy is itself a control and must be verifiable like every other one
